```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")

library(clusterProfiler)
library(enrichplot)
library(simplifyEnrichment)
library(rrvgo)
library(gt)
```

Over-representation analysis of the candidate NON-ESTABLISHED genes from
`06_additional_filtering_save.Rmd`, against all genes in the Exomiser results
as background.

## Settings and inputs

```{r inputs}
enrich_dir <- file.path(figures_dir, "enrichment")
dir.create(enrich_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Appended to every output file name
enrich_tag <- paste0("rank", candidate_max_rank, remove_vars,
                     "_no_monogen_old_gene_Exomiser", exomiser_version)

save_enrich_plot <- function(plot, name, width, height) {
  ggsave(file.path(enrich_dir, paste0(name, "_", enrich_tag, ".pdf")), plot,
         width = width, height = height)
  save(plot, file = file.path(images_dir, paste0(name, "_", enrich_tag, ".RData")))
}

# Background: every gene in the (ESTABLISHED + NON-ESTABLISHED) Exomiser results
all_genes <- read_tsv(all_vars_file, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  distinct(GENE_SYMBOL) %>%
  pull()

candidates <- read_tsv(candidates_file, show_col_types = FALSE)
gene_list  <- candidates$GENE_SYMBOL

message("Background genes: ", length(all_genes), " | Candidate genes: ", length(gene_list))
```

## Candidate genes

```{r candidate-table}
candidate_table <- candidates %>%
  select(GENE_SYMBOL, N_Cases, N_Controls, MEAN_PHENO_SCORE, MEAN_VARIANT_SCORE) %>%
  gt(rowname_col = "GENE_SYMBOL") %>%
  fmt_number(c(MEAN_PHENO_SCORE, MEAN_VARIANT_SCORE), decimals = 2)

gtsave(candidate_table, file.path(results_dir, paste0("Non_ESTABLISHED_candidate_genes_", enrich_tag, ".docx")))
candidate_table
```

## GO enrichment (biological process)

```{r go-enrich}
go_enrich <- enrichGO(gene          = gene_list,
                      universe      = all_genes,
                      OrgDb         = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                      keyType       = "SYMBOL",
                      ont           = "BP",
                      pAdjustMethod = "BH",
                      pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                      qvalueCutoff  = 0.05)

# Collapse redundant GO terms (Wang semantic similarity > 0.5)
go_enrich_simple <- clusterProfiler::simplify(go_enrich, cutoff = 0.5, by = "p.adjust",
                                              select_fun = min, measure = "Wang")

message("Enriched GO terms: ", nrow(go_enrich), " | after simplify: ", nrow(go_enrich_simple))
if (nrow(go_enrich_simple) == 0) stop("No enriched GO terms -- nothing to plot.")

save(go_enrich_simple, file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("go_enrich_", enrich_tag, ".RData")))

go_enrich_simple %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(ID, Description, GeneRatio, pvalue, p.adjust, geneID, Count) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 4)
```

### Dot plot

```{r go-dotplot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
go_dotplot <- dotplot(go_enrich_simple, font.size = 18) +
  scale_size_area(max_size = 15) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 16))

go_dotplot
save_enrich_plot(go_dotplot, "GO_BP_dotplot", width = 10, height = 8)
```

### UpSet plot

```{r go-upsetplot, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 5}
go_upsetplot <- upsetplot(go_enrich_simple) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, angle = 90, vjust = 0.5),  # gene set names
        axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18))                           # overlap counts

go_upsetplot
save_enrich_plot(go_upsetplot, "GO_BP_upsetplot", width = 9, height = 5)
```

### Bar plot

```{r go-barplot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
go_barplot <- barplot(go_enrich_simple,
                      drop         = TRUE,
                      showCategory = 10,
                      title        = "GO Biological Pathways",
                      font.size    = 18) +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
        legend.text  = element_text(size = 16))

go_barplot
save_enrich_plot(go_barplot, "GO_BP_barplot", width = 10, height = 8)
```

### GO graph

```{r go-goplot, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 8}
go_goplot <- goplot(go_enrich_simple, showCategory = 10)

go_goplot
save_enrich_plot(go_goplot, "GO_BP_goplot", width = 10, height = 8)
```

## KEGG enrichment

Needs an internet connection (KEGG is queried online). Genes without an
Entrez ID are dropped.

```{r kegg-enrich}
ids <- bitr(all_genes, fromType = "SYMBOL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db") %>%
  distinct(SYMBOL, .keep_all = TRUE)

kegg_genes <- ids$ENTREZID[ids$SYMBOL %in% gene_list]
message("Candidate genes with an Entrez ID: ", length(kegg_genes), " of ", length(gene_list))

kk <- enrichKEGG(gene          = kegg_genes,
                 universe      = ids$ENTREZID,
                 organism      = "hsa",
                 keyType       = "kegg",
                 pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
                 pAdjustMethod = "BH")

save(kk, file = file.path(results_dir, paste0("kegg_enrich_", enrich_tag, ".RData")))

kk_ok <- !is.null(kk) && nrow(kk) > 0
message("Enriched KEGG pathways: ", if (kk_ok) nrow(kk) else 0)
if (kk_ok) knitr::kable(head(as_tibble(kk), 10), digits = 4)
```

```{r kegg-plots, fig.width = 6, fig.height = 8}
if (kk_ok) {
  kegg_barplot <- barplot(kk, showCategory = 10, title = "Enriched Pathways", font.size = 8)
  print(kegg_barplot)
  save_enrich_plot(kegg_barplot, "KEGG_barplot", width = 6, height = 8)

  kegg_dotplot <- dotplot(kk, showCategory = 10, title = "Enriched Pathways", font.size = 8)
  print(kegg_dotplot)
  save_enrich_plot(kegg_dotplot, "KEGG_dotplot", width = 6, height = 8)
}
```

## GO term clustering (simplifyEnrichment)

Significant GO terms from the unsimplified enrichment, clustered by semantic
similarity with the binary-cut method.

```{r simplify-enrichment, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7}
go_ids <- go_enrich@result$ID[go_enrich@result$p.adjust < 0.05]
go_sim <- GO_similarity(go_ids, ont = "BP", db = "org.Hs.eg.db")

# Draws the heatmap and returns the cluster of each GO term
go_clusters <- simplifyGO(go_sim, method = "binary_cut", column_title = "Simplified GO Terms")

go_clusters %>% arrange(cluster) %>% knitr::kable()
```

## GO term reduction (rrvgo)

```{r rrvgo, fig.width = 9, fig.height = 7}
go_results <- as.data.frame(go_enrich)
go_scores  <- setNames(-log10(go_results$p.adjust), go_results$ID)  # higher = more significant

rrvgo_sim <- calculateSimMatrix(go_results$ID,
                                orgdb  = "org.Hs.eg.db",
                                ont    = "BP",
                                method = "Rel")

# Lower threshold = fewer, broader parent terms (0.7 is the rrvgo default)
reduced_terms <- reduceSimMatrix(rrvgo_sim, go_scores,
                                 threshold = 0.4,
                                 orgdb     = "org.Hs.eg.db")

scatterPlot(rrvgo_sim, reduced_terms, labelSize = 5)
treemapPlot(reduced_terms)

reduced_terms %>%
  select(go, term, parentTerm, score) %>%
  arrange(parentTerm, desc(score)) %>%
  knitr::kable(digits = 2)
```
